parent_objective: audit bounded calibration smoke task-quality result
blocked_by: need result audit before interpreting calibration quality or scaling

public_gates: M1709 must audit M1708 execution pass/fail and task-quality calibration rules
M1709 must classify whether the bounded smoke found an interpretable calibration variant
M1709 must decide whether to scale, repair, or synthesize the branch
M1709 must not train replay PPO promote use private holdout or change actor inputs
M1709 must not claim controller-family ranking, paper-level evidence, private-holdout evidence, or level3 self-ID

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits bounded calibration smoke execution and decides task-quality route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no new rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if M1708 execution did not pass
stop if outcome aggregates are missing
stop if audit tries to rank profiles
stop if all variants remain off-track dominated and no repair route is specified
fallback_plan: route to calibrated execution scale-up design if task-quality signal is positive
route to task geometry repair if all variants remain off-track dominated
route to branch synthesis if evidence is mixed or cadence requires it
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1708 completes bounded calibration smoke execution

admission_evidence: M1708 writes execution artifacts and outcome aggregates
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1709 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up scale-up design, repair, or synthesis manifest
next_stage_criteria: execution result is audited against M1707 thresholds

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1709 audits task-quality calibration and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audit may inspect profile controls but must not treat M1708 as self-ID evidence
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If all variants remain off-track dominated, record task-quality null and route to repair rather than profile ranking.
allowed_claims: no rollout, no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no promotion, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1708 can be audited as clean execution and the calibration variants can be classified under the pre-registered M1707 task-quality rules.
success_criteria: best calibration variant and original-axis baseline are compared
interpretability threshold and weak-signal threshold are evaluated
next scale-up repair or synthesis route is explicit
training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit makes paper-level or self-ID claims
environment rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur

commands.name: audit
commands.command: audit M1708 bounded calibration smoke result

decision_rule: M1709 passes if it audits M1708 and routes to scale-up, repair, or synthesis without overclaiming.
